usedFor: Connecteam holds staff, and Google Docs gets a note per “New User” via “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User” in Connecteam, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A newly created user is written into a doc tab as soon as Connecteam records it.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's content, so test “User Updated” runs before you trust them.
